note: 24 Gated-DeltaNet layers + 8 full-attention layers. UNLIKE qwen3.5-0.8b/2b, the GDN key and value head counts are DECOUPLED (16 key heads, 32 value heads) — Q/K are broadcast (repeat_interleave) up to the value head count before the recurrence; V is already at 32. State tensor is [32,128,128], not [16,128,128]. NOT an official OE-LLM architecture; BLLM-native only. The vision half of the checkpoint is dropped for the text package (see the qwen3.5-vlm recipe).

quantisation.kept_fp32: SSM recurrence, depthwise conv, RMSNorms, GDN gated-norm
quantisation.note: Flat +-32/+-64 activation ranges clip this size's deep linears (measured max|input| ~198 on 'down', ~84 on q/k/v, ~65 on the GDN gates) into a degenerate loop. Calibration: max|input| * 1.3 margin from a real fp32 decode forward over a small prompt set, recorded per linear.

variants.name: qwen3.5-4b-ctx4k-int8-s100
variants.prefill: chunked-float-N32; head-splitting adapted for the decoupled GDN heads, chunked-delta-rule math itself unchanged from qwen3.5-0.8b/2b (see README)

toolchain.note: Recorded so a future regression can be attributed. Host toolchain and board HBRT must match.

measured.note: S100P, 2026-07-26, performance mode set (0x2b047000/0x2b047004 = 0x99, re-written and read back this session). Measured two ways: (1) hrt_model_exec perf directly on the decode .hbm, 20 frames, single thread, dedicated core; (2) chat() through the image+text package (same decode sub-graph as the text-only package), 3 repeated runs, decode_tok_s identical to 2 decimal places across all 3 (3.29 each run). Board had another model's serving process stopped for the duration, restored afterward.

rejected_builds.name: flat int16 activation ranges (copied from 0.8b/2b)
rejected_builds.why: The flat +-32/+-64 ranges that fit 0.8b/2b clip this size's deep linears (real max|input| up to ~198 vs the +-64 range on 'down') into a degenerate loop. The build compiles and runs fluently — it just answers wrong. Fixed by per-linear calibration; see README.

rejected_builds.name: symmetric GDN head split (copied from 0.8b/2b prefill recipe without adapting for decoupled heads)
rejected_builds.why: This model's checkpoint has linear_num_key_heads=16, linear_num_value_heads=32 (vs 16/16 on the smaller siblings). A prefill graph ported from a symmetric sibling without inserting the Q/K broadcast-to-value-head-count step, and without moving the tensor split boundaries to be key-head-width for Q/K and value-head-width for V, does not match the checkpoint's actual weight shapes.

rejected_builds.name: block_quantized_matmul (dynamic-quant decode)
rejected_builds.why: Same failure as qwen3.5-0.8b: the dynamic per-token quant path is a PREFILL op, ~130x slower per matmul in decode.

rejected_builds.name: all-BPU chunked prefill (Newton triangular inverse)
rejected_builds.why: Same numerical failure as qwen3.5-0.8b — not re-derived at this size, the mechanism is head-count independent.

board_verification.flow: docker stop the resident serving container; bllm.load(dir) in isolation; hrt_model_exec perf on the decode graph directly + chat() (3 repeated runs); restore the stopped container
